description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Gampola, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District (24/1190)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration particulars. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and other property-related details, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
